title: hieracium juelii
intro: Hieracium juelii, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the dandelion-like flowering plant family, Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium juelii are thought to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit potential anticancer properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are known to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
